name: Artifact Verification
description: Accept an artifact only after readback shows a non-empty file of the expected type.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the artifact back by the id the tool returned.
Read the same artifact through the read alias.
Find an existing artifact in this session.
Read the persisted document back as text.

validation.rule: artifact_get succeeded for the cited artifactId, the size is greater than 0, and the mime type matches the expected type. Zero-byte, unreadable, and wrong-type results fail.
